result.body:
# Executive communications retrospective

## April 3, 2023 onboarding-trigger briefing
The second-cohort result made the onboarding-trigger experiment a settled win. The executive briefing could therefore present the result as conclusively established, with no further confirmation needed before leadership treated the matter as closed.

args.body: Correction: On April 3, the second-cohort confirmation was encouraging—pooled week-1 retention was +3.1 points versus control (p=0.04, n=420)—and Riley called the ship while remaining cautiously optimistic. The result was not treated as fully settled: SRM, signup-source mix, country/device skew, and the planned post-ship cohort still needed review before drawing a final conclusion.
